knowledge_point.title: Applying Row Operations To a Coefficients Matrix

question.:question/problem:
Consider the matrix $B,$ given by

$$
B=\begin{bmatrix}2 & -3 & 4 \\ -5 & 1 & 7 \\ 3 & 8 & -2\end{bmatrix}.
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the following row operations on $B?$

$$
\begin{aligned}{R}_{1} & :={R}_{1}+{R}_{2} \\ {R}_{1} & :={R}_{1}+2{R}_{3}\end{aligned}
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Let's list the required operations:

- The operation ${R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+{R}_{2}$ means that we need to add $1$ times the second row to the first row.

- The operation ${R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+2{R}_{3}$ means that we need to add $2$ times the third row to the first row.

Applying the operations, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}B & =\begin{bmatrix}2 & -3 & 4 \\ -5 & 1 & 7 \\ 3 & 8 & -2\end{bmatrix}\quad {R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+{R}_{2} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}2+(1)(-5) & -3+(1)(1) & 4+(1)(7) \\ -5 & 1 & 7 \\ 3 & 8 & -2\end{bmatrix} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}-3 & -2 & 11 \\ -5 & 1 & 7 \\ 3 & 8 & -2\end{bmatrix}\quad {R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+2{R}_{3} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}-3+(2)(3) & -2+(2)(8) & 11+(2)(-2) \\ -5 & 1 & 7 \\ 3 & 8 & -2\end{bmatrix} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}3 & 14 & 7 \\ -5 & 1 & 7 \\ 3 & 8 & -2\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$
